<?php

// PRESERVED, NOT FIXED (see php.go's stateFunctionBodyOrReturnType doc):
// an interface method forward-declaration WITH a return-type hint
// (`): string;`, no body) drives PHPLanguageStates into
// _function_body_or_return_type, which has no ";" (or "}") case at all --
// only "{" -- so the state machine gets stuck there, silently absorbing
// every token (including the interface's own closing brace) until the
// very next literal "{" anywhere later in the file, which it then
// mistakes for THIS forward declaration's own body. This file is kept
// deliberately isolated (nothing meaningful after the trigger) so the
// quirk is provable without silently swallowing unrelated corpus
// coverage the way it would if mixed into a larger fixture.
interface Greets {
    public function greet(): string;
}

function afterInterface($x) {
    return $x;
}
